title: School office: your lunch account is overdue
scenario: A text that looks like it's from your school says your lunch account balance is overdue and asks you to pay through a link before your card is blocked at checkout.

answers.A: Pay through the link quickly so lunch isn't blocked.
answers.B: Forward the link to friends so they can pay too.
answers.C: Check the balance directly in the school's official payment app or ask the school office.

explanation: School payment systems don't threaten to block your lunch by text with an outside link - a real balance issue shows up in the official app or a letter home.
proTip: Go straight to the account you already have, not a link a text sends you.
